must_identify.item: The pod is Pending with FailedScheduling Insufficient cpu
must_identify.evidence: The pod's scheduling failure event explicitly confirms `0/3 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint(s), 2 Insufficient cpu` [6].

must_identify.item: The cause is the 64-core CPU request, above any node's allocatable CPU
must_identify.evidence: The root cause was a resource request misconfiguration on the `worker` Deployment: the live spec requested `cpu: 64` (64 whole CPU cores) for the pod container, whereas every worker node in the cluster has only 10 allocatable CPU cores [8], making the request impossible to satisfy on any node.

notes: The RCA never gives an explicit remediation step, though it does identify 50m as the intended value. It mentions the control-plane taint only to rule it out as a cause.
